Read input: origen_047005.v · Open raw
module origen_047005(
    input clk,
    output reg [7:0] led,
    output reg [3:0] servo
);

    reg [63:0] mem [0:255];
    reg [7:0] ptr;
    reg [63:0] data;
    reg [31:0] run;
    reg [9:0] tf;
    reg tf_en;
    reg [15:0] t0, t1, t2, t3;

    initial begin
        $readmemh("ram.txt", mem);
        ptr = 0;
        run = 0;
        tf = 0;
        tf_en = 0;
        t0 = 0;
        t1 = 0;
        t2 = 0;
        t3 = 0;
    end

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        run <= run + 1;
        tf <= (tf == 599) ? 0 : tf + 1;
        tf_en <= (run[10:0] == 0);
        
        if (tf == 0) begin
            ptr <= ptr + 1;
            data <= mem[ptr];
            t0 <= data[15:0];
            t1 <= data[31:16];
            t2 <= data[47:32];
            t3 <= data[63:48];
        end else if (tf_en) begin
            if (t0 > 0) t0 <= t0 - 1;
            if (t1 > 0) t1 <= t1 - 1;
            if (t2 > 0) t2 <= t2 - 1;
            if (t3 > 0) t3 <= t3 - 1;
        end

        led <= run[31:24];
        servo[0] <= (t0 != 0);
        servo[1] <= (t1 != 0);
        servo[2] <= (t2 != 0);
        servo[3] <= (t3 != 0);
    end

endmodule
